correctness.rationale: The Grassmannian binary-cubic restriction gives four coefficients. After linear tangent elimination, the quadratic coefficient is kappa(t)e^2 and cubic is tau(t)e^3. At ordinary points kappa is a unit, giving e^2=0; at nine simple flexes kappa has simple zero and tau is unit, giving (t e^2,e^3). The conormal first layer is O_E(1), the second is nine length-one skyscrapers; Riemann-Roch yields 3n+3(n+1)+9=6n+12. Independent local Groebner and Hilbert identities checked.
